About

Hi, I'm Adeleke Oyinkansola Esther

Also known as Eliza. I help YouTube and Twitch creators grow with the full picture, not just one piece of it. That's promotion to get your videos in front of the right audience, monetization set up and optimized, and day-to-day channel management so nothing slips through the cracks. On the technical side, I handle SEO, video editing, and full channel audits that show exactly where growth is stalling. For streamers, I build Twitch promotion and branding that makes your channel instantly recognizable. Whether you're just starting out or scaling steadily, I handle the behind-the-scenes work so you can focus on creating.
